7) Explain Peer-to-Peer Compu Ɵng Model  
Peer-to-peer compu Ɵng architecture is a network where all nodes (computers) are equal and share 
data with each other . All tasks are divided equally among the nodes . The nodes communicate with 
each other as needed and share their resources . 
 
Characteris Ɵcs of Peer-to-Peer Compu Ɵng 
 Peer-to-peer networks are usually made up of small groups of computers (around a do

eer Compu Ɵng 
 Peer-to-peer networks are usually made up of small groups of computers (around a dozen or 
less). Each computer stores its data with its own security but also shares data with other nodes . 
 In this network, each node both uses resources and provides resources . So, when the number of 
nodes increases, the resource sharing capacity also increases . This is different from client-server 
networks where the server can become overloaded when more nodes are added. 
 Since each node works as both a client and a server , it becomes difficult to maintain proper 
security. This may lead to problems like denial of service (DoS) attacks . 
 Most modern operating systems like Windows and Mac OS  already have software to support 
peer-to-peer networks . 
Advantages of P2P Networks/Compu Ɵng Model:  
1. No dedicated server required.  
2. Less expensive.  
3. Easy to install and maintain.
